overall_goal: Weigh ingredients, clean the workspace, and wash hands

goals.description: Weigh and log the whole tomato
goals.rationale: The person places a whole tomato on the scale to check its weight and then writes the measurement down in a notebook.
The person retrieves a bowl, places it on the scale, zeroes it, and transfers the chopped tomato into the bowl to weigh it.
The person turns on the tap, washes their hands in the sink, and dries them with a kitchen towel.

goals.description: Discard food waste into the bin
goals.rationale: The person uses a knife to scrape onion peels and tomato seeds off the chopping board into the rubbish bin, and picks up a dropped piece from the floor.

goals.description: Wash the chopping board and dry hands
goals.rationale: The person takes the plastic chopping board to the sink, washes and shakes it dry, returns it to the counter, and then dries their hands.
